options.name: adjust_tcp_mss
options.description: Adjust TCP MSS for layer3 interface.

options.name: api_key
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The API key to use instead of generating it using I(username) / I(password).

options.name: comment
options.description: Interface comment.

options.name: create_default_route
options.description: Whether or not to add default route with router learned via DHCP.

options.name: dhcp_default_route_metric
options.description: Metric for the DHCP default route.

options.name: enable_dhcp
options.description: Enable DHCP on this interface.

options.name: gathered_filter
options.description: When I(state=gathered). An advanced filtering option to filter results returned from PAN-OS. Refer to the guide discussing I(gathered_filter) for more information.

options.name: ip
options.description: List of static IP addresses.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The IP address or hostname of the PAN-OS device being configured.

options.name: ipv4_mss_adjust
options.description: (7.1+) TCP MSS adjustment for IPv4.

options.name: ipv6_enabled
options.description: Enable IPv6.

options.name: ipv6_mss_adjust
options.description: (7.1+) TCP MSS adjustment for IPv6.

options.name: lr_name
options.description: Logical router to add this interface to. Takes precedence over 'vr_name' and has no default.

options.name: management_profile
options.description: Interface management profile name.

options.name: mtu
options.description: MTU for layer3 interface.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the interface to configure.

options.name: netflow_profile
options.description: Netflow profile for layer3 interface.

options.name: parent_interface
options.description: Name of the parent interface

options.name: password
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The password to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: port
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The port number to connect to the PAN-OS device on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: The state.

options.name: tag
options.description: Tag (vlan id) for the interface

options.name: template
options.description: (Panorama only) The template this operation should target.  This param is required if the PAN-OS device is Panorama.

options.name: username
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The username to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: vr_name
options.description: Virtual router to add this interface to.

options.name: vsys
options.description: The vsys this object should be imported into.  Objects that are imported include interfaces, virtual routers, virtual wires, and VLANs.  Interfaces are typically imported into vsys1 if no vsys is specified.

options.name: zone_name
options.description: Name of the zone for the interface. If the zone does not exist it is created.
